inputSchema.title: CreateMondayBoardRequest

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: ID of the folder for the board. If `workspace_id` is absent, the board uses this folder's containing workspace. If `workspace_id` is present, this folder must be within the specified workspace.

board_kind.title: Board Kind
board_kind.description: The kind of board to create, determining its visibility and access.

board_name.title: Board Name
board_name.description: The name for the new board.

description.title: Description
examples: Central board for tracking all Project Phoenix deliverables.
Roadmap and initiatives for the Q3 marketing campaign.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: ID of an accessible template to use for the new board.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: Numeric ID of the workspace for the board. Use MONDAY_GET_WORKSPACES action to retrieve valid workspace IDs. This field is optional - if omitted, the board is created in the default workspace. If `folder_id` is given, this workspace must contain that folder.

board_owner_ids.title: Board Owner Ids
board_owner_ids.description: User IDs to be assigned as owners of the board.

board_subscriber_ids.title: Board Subscriber Ids
board_subscriber_ids.description: User IDs to be subscribed to the board.

board_subscriber_teams_ids.title: Board Subscriber Teams Ids
board_subscriber_teams_ids.description: Team IDs to be subscribed to the board.

inputSchema.description: Request to create a new board in Monday.com, specifying its name, kind, and optional properties.
